vlock_message.description: The message displayed when the console is locked. Overrides VLOCK_ALL_MESSAGE and VLOCK_CURRENT_MESSAGE.

vlock_all_message.description: The message displayed when all consoles are locked.

vlock_current_message.description: The message displayed when only the current console is locked.

vlock_plugins.description: A list of plugin names to load when vlock starts. Space-separated in the environment variable.

vlock_timeout.description: The timeout in seconds after which screensaver plugins are invoked. 0 means no timeout.

vlock_prompt_timeout.description: The timeout in seconds for entering the password at the prompt. 0 means no timeout.

vlock_user.description: The user to lock the screen as when running as root. Usually the actual invoking user.
